topics.title: Standard I: Cosmetology fields, hair, skin and nail anatomy

outcomes.text: Tell apart the anatomy of hair, skin and nails.
Identify body processes of hair, nails and skin that affect bacteria growth, such as skin pH.
Carry out sanitation, sterilisation, first aid and personal and professional hygiene in the salon.
Identify tissues, bones, muscles and nerves relevant to massage strokes and safe pressure.
Categorise cosmetology careers such as stylist, makeup artist, nail technician, salon manager and owner.

units.title: Domain B: SKIN (Skin Types, Treatment, and Makeup)

topics.title: Standard I: Skin anatomy and treatments

outcomes.text: Name the layers of skin and explain its role, complexion, types and conditions.
Identify different skin types and conditions.
Recommend products and facials suited to a client's skin type and condition.
Identify skin tools and equipment and mix products for cleansing, polishing and a complete facial.

topics.title: Standard I: Nail anatomy and treatments

outcomes.text: Identify nail structure, health needs and diseases.
Evaluate symptoms of nail disorders, diseases and allergies and refer clients to medical help.
Distinguish treatable from untreatable nail conditions.
Identify tools, products and equipment for manicures and pedicures.
Set up manicure and pedicure stations and prep clients.
Give pressure point hand and foot massage.
Carry out manicure steps: trimming, five nail shapes, cuticle care, buffing, scrubbing, masks, massage and polish.
Complete a full mani/pedi service within the allotted time.

topics.title: Standard I: Hair styling, colouring and treatments

outcomes.text: Identify hair structure, types and textures.
Assess hair porosity, density, texture and treated versus untreated hair.
Create natural treatments for dry, oily, damaged, treated, fungal, hair fall and alopecia problems.
Apply basic shampooing principles.
Describe threading history and hair removal techniques.
Identify facial hair removal tools and products.
Map eyebrows and shape symmetrical brows by face shape.
Thread different parts of the face.
Perform threading and facial waxing on self and others.
Wax different parts of the face.

units.title: Domain B: SKIN (Skin Types, Treatment, and Makeup)

topics.title: Standard I: Skin anatomy and treatments

outcomes.text: Keep brushes, products and makeup kits hygienic, and avoid contamination and expired products; set up facial stations and prep clients.
Perform cleansing, toning, steam, extraction, exfoliation, masks, massage, serums and eye care by skin type.

topics.title: Standard I: Hair styling, colouring and treatments

outcomes.text: Identify tools and products for rebonding, perming and keratin treatments.
Assess client hair needs by type, texture, colour and style preference.
Carry out rebonding, perming and keratin treatments with aftercare advice.
Spot mistakes and correct the treatment plan.
Identify styling tools and set the trolley and client.
Section and tease hair for blowdries, half updos and full updos.
Do blowdries, heat curls, straightening, crimping, beach waves, buns and updos.
Match face shape to accessories and dupatta for makeup looks.
Identify tools and products for sugaring, lemon wax and fruit wax.
Make lemon wax and sugaring for hair removal.
Analyse skin type and suggest the best wax.
Identify and handle problems such as ingrown hair, sensitive skin, thin skin and wax burns.
Heat wax correctly, prep skin, apply and remove strips, and give aftercare.
Wax pregnant women and mature skin.

units.title: Domain B: SKIN (Skin Types, Treatment, and Makeup)

topics.title: Standard I: Skin anatomy and treatments

outcomes.text: Summarise skin anatomy and present its structure and diseases.
Identify tools, products and machines for hydra, HiFu, carbon facials, chemical peels and microdermabrasion.
Carry out those advanced treatments hands-on by skin type and condition.
Analyse a client's skin and give a detailed treatment plan.
Demonstrate face lifting: hand massage, gua sha or roller, T-hammer.
Keep machines and equipment hygienic for each procedure.

topics.title: Standard I: Hair styling, colouring and treatments

outcomes.text: Identify hair tools and set the trolley and client.
Section hair for cutting.
Recommend cuts by face shape and hair texture.
Perform layered cuts, bobs, bangs and wedge cuts.
Use colour theory and correct colour on different tones and textures.
Read shade cards and colour tubes.
Apply foils, weaving and slicing.
Identify colouring tools and set the trolley and client.
Analyse hair and propose a colour and dye type.
Do root touch-ups, full colour, lightening, highlights, lowlights, baby lights and balayage.
Identify massage oils and their benefits.
Set up a massage station and prep clients.
Explain muscle anatomy for massage strokes.
Perform effleurage, kneading, scissor stroke, acupressure and correct pressure.
Carry out massage services such as prenatal, deep tissue, post natal, hot stone and compression.
Make sugar, ubtan and malai scrubs for client needs.
Apply, exfoliate and remove scrubs.

topics.title: Standard I: Nail anatomy and treatments

outcomes.text: Summarise nail anatomy and present its structure.
Interpret nail product chemistry and dispose of nail chemicals properly.
Identify tools, products and equipment for acrylic, gel and nail art.
Shape tips, prep the nail bed and apply, colour and ombre acrylics, preventing lifting.
Polish, design, create nail art and apply accessories.
Keep an acrylic nail set hygienic.
Complete a full acrylic nail service within the allotted time.

topics.title: Standard I: Hair styling, colouring and treatments

outcomes.text: Execute at least three bridal hairstyle types with accessory and dupatta settings.
Identify laser tools and equipment and prep the station.
Understand appropriate laser parameters, techniques and safety, plus machine handling, gel and laser and IPL types.
Learn the basic principles of laser physics.
Select technology and session numbers for different skin types.
Identify common mistakes: cooling gel, skin contact, goggles, IPL filters and burns.

topics.title: Standard I: Running a beauty business

outcomes.text: Develop business plan areas: problem, target audience, market size, SWOT.
Do quantitative and qualitative market research.
Develop a go-to-market strategy from research.
Present a business plan covering problem, solution, audience, value proposition, competitors, strategy and forecast.
Produce cash flow, basic profit and loss, forecasting and budget in Excel.
Create social media pages and attract audience on Instagram and TikTok.
Build HR skills: client dealing, reception, employee management.
Manage inventory: minimum stock, vendors, orders.
Keep records in Excel: orders, bookkeeping, feedback.
Identify factors that make up a client's salon experience.

warnings: unit "Domain D: Hair" (grade 12) has a single outcome
